tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind everything (body background).

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised floating layers above the canvas: tooltips, hint bubbles.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, sheets. Use instead of bg-white.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, nested surfaces, neutral badges, hover fill on ghost and outline buttons, empty states.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Third level: hover on secondary buttons, skeleton shimmer.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline around cards, inputs, dividers. Decorative only: 1.2:1 on surface, so never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger divider and scrollbar thumb. 1.4:1 on surface; decorative.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Faint row dividers inside lists.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Titles and primary text on bg, surface, surface-2 and surface-3 (about 15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Body copy and descriptions on bg, surface and surface-2 (7:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, hints, placeholders. FLAG: dark theme measures 4.25:1 on bg, 3.9:1 on surface and 3.6:1 on surface-2, below 4.5:1 for small text (the source comment claims 4.6:1). Light theme passes on bg and surface (4.6–4.8:1). Use for 12px+ secondary text only, never for anything the user must read to act.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, focus ring, active nav, info badges. Dark: 8.3:1 on surface. FLAG light: 3.4:1 on surface, so accent text below 18px bold fails 4.5:1; use it for fills and icons, and use text for small text links.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background of info badges and selected rows; text on it is accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger tint for active or pressed selected states.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (primary buttons). Dark 6.8:1. FLAG light: white on accent is 3.4:1, below 4.5:1 for the 14px button label.

tokens.name: scout
tokens.usage: Scout agent identity where it follows the theme (CSS variable). Dark 6.5:1, light 5.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: scout-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind Scout identity marks.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status: high scores, completed, saved. Dark 10.2:1 on surface. FLAG light: 3.3:1, so pair with an icon or word and keep it to 12px+ semibold badges.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges; text on it is success.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on success fills (success buttons). 8.4:1 dark, 4.5:1 light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, required-field asterisk. 6.5:1 dark, 4.8:1 light on surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges; text on it is danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills (destructive buttons). 6.4:1 dark, 4.8:1 light.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention status: mid scores, interview stage, Coach. Dark 10.2:1. FLAG light: 3.2:1 on surface; pair with icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges; text on it is warning.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Scorer-family accents and shortlisted state. 7.5:1 dark, 5.7:1 light on surface.

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind purple marks.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 3px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element. Follows accent. FLAG light: 3.4:1 on surface, just above the 3:1 floor for focus indicators.

tokens.name: agent-scout
tokens.usage: Fixed Scout identity colour from agents.ts, the same in every theme (StageTrack, AgentBadge, sidebar agent list). FLAG: 2.8:1 on the light surface, so it reads only as a mark beside the agent name, never as text.

tokens.name: agent-scout-soft
tokens.usage: Fixed tint behind Scout identity marks; same in every theme.

tokens.name: agent-scorer
tokens.usage: Fixed Scorer identity colour from agents.ts, the same in every theme (StageTrack, AgentBadge, sidebar agent list). FLAG: 2.4:1 on the light surface, so it reads only as a mark beside the agent name, never as text.

tokens.name: agent-scorer-soft
tokens.usage: Fixed tint behind Scorer identity marks; same in every theme.

tokens.name: agent-tailor
tokens.usage: Fixed Tailor identity colour from agents.ts, the same in every theme (StageTrack, AgentBadge, sidebar agent list). FLAG: 1.8:1 on the light surface, so it reads only as a mark beside the agent name, never as text.

tokens.name: agent-tailor-soft
tokens.usage: Fixed tint behind Tailor identity marks; same in every theme.

tokens.name: agent-coach
tokens.usage: Fixed Coach identity colour from agents.ts, the same in every theme (StageTrack, AgentBadge, sidebar agent list). FLAG: 1.8:1 on the light surface, so it reads only as a mark beside the agent name, never as text.

tokens.name: agent-coach-soft
tokens.usage: Fixed tint behind Coach identity marks; same in every theme.

styles.usage: PageHeader h1 from 640px up (text-2xl sm:text-[28px], tracking-tight). One per page.

spacing.note: Hatch defines no spacing variables; components use the Tailwind default 4px scale. These are the steps the components actually use.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in compact chips (gap-1).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, form-field rows (grid gap-2), icon and label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Dialog close button inset; list item spacing in reports (space-y-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: SectionCard padding below 640px; dialog vertical padding; header-to-content gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: SectionCard padding from 640px; dialog horizontal padding; AlertDialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (p-6); PageHeader bottom margin (mb-6).

tokens.name: radius-compact
tokens.usage: Chips, small tags, skeleton bars.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, the sidebar brand tile.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, section cards, dialogs, popovers, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Large panels and page-level containers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, pills, dots.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Compatibility value; no current component uses it.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Compatibility alias of radius-compact. New components use radius-compact.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Compatibility alias of radius-control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Compatibility alias of radius-card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Compatibility alias of radius-panel.

tokens.name: r-field
tokens.usage: Compatibility alias of radius-control (fields).

tokens.name: r-card
tokens.usage: Compatibility alias of radius-card.

tokens.name: r-btn
tokens.usage: Compatibility alias of radius-control (buttons).

tokens.name: r-chip
tokens.usage: Compatibility alias of radius-compact (chips).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and primary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, alert dialogs, sheets.

tokens.name: control-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every interactive control (hatch-interactive). Buttons drop to 40px from 640px.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: Horizontal page padding: 16px on phones up to 32px on wide screens.
